text:
Sam (Billing): Heads-up — Harmonix Labs invoice INV-2025-198 shows the promo line didn’t apply; customer was charged full for reserved capacity instead of the 50% promo. Requesting manual credit and customer notification.

Maya G: Can you paste the invoice lines and total? I’ll sanity-check.

Sam (Billing): Sure. snippet: ```
INV-2025-198
Line 1: Reserved GPU (monthly) x1 — $3,000
Promo (HARM-50) expected -$1,500
Applied promo: $0
Total: $3,000
Suggested credit: $1,500 (goodwill)
```

Priya (Sales): Customer is on trial promo; we promised 50% for Q1. Agree $1.5k credit. I’ll loop customer in after finance ok. @Alex W please confirm we can do manual adjustment on the invoice.

Alex W: Yup we can issue a credit memo. Need PO or sign-off. Do we want to do the full credit or prorate for remaining term? Looks like they used ~14 days of the month.

Sam (Billing): They were charged for full month but used ~14 days. Recommend issuing the promised promo credit now ($1,500) and prorate next invoice. Customer contact: ellie@harmonix.ai. PO not required for credits under $5k.

InvoicingBot: Created credit request CR-2151239999; status: pending-approval.

Jordan (CFO): Approve $1,500 credit. Please add note ‘promo misapplied - goodwill’ and CC the customer with an apology. :thumbsup: 

Priya (Sales): Thanks! I’ll draft the apology email and CC ops. Sam, please proceed to create the credit memo and tag me once completed.

Alex W: Will create credit memo and apply to account today. tagging #billing for visibility.
